name: Process Monitoring and Hijacking via SilentProcessExit
description: Detects the configuration of SilentProcessExit registry keys. Adversaries can use this feature to monitor for a process ending and launch a malicious process or DLL in its place for persistence or credential theft.

action.description: A SilentProcessExit monitoring entry was created or modified. This is a sophisticated technique for persistence, credential dumping (e.g., lsass.exe), or process hijacking.

operational_usage: Investigate which process is being monitored (the key name) and what actions are configured (e.g., 'MonitorProcess', 'ReportingMode'). This technique is often used to dump lsass.exe memory upon termination.
false_positive: Very rare. Windows Error Reporting may use this mechanism. However, any manual or scripted configuration by non-system processes is highly suspicious and warrants investigation.
